info.title: Identity M1 + M2 P5/P6
info.description: Accepted 2026-11-13. Auth POST success 200; no Idempotency-Key. Refresh rotates within absolute seven-day session; logout requires matching verified sub/sid and current refresh. Revoked retry allowed until refresh expiry, access must remain valid. Email/display_name trimmed; password preserved. Local trusted network only; internal context headers cannot be supplied by public clients. LOCKED valid credentials: 403. Access may survive logout for up to 900s.

post.description: ACTIVE OWNER only, existing ACTIVE invitee, no membership even INACTIVE. Unique PENDING per org/recipient; expired PENDING becomes EXPIRED before new creation. Snapshot immutable. Replay requires current OWNER, not original eligibility. Seven-day absolute expiry (expires_at <= current time), checked after locks. Idempotency success TTL 24h, key wait 2s; replay checks current rights before cached success, never requires PENDING. No invitation event. Error envelope and auth/session M1 unchanged.

post.description: ACTIVE recipient only; fresh accept requires inviter ACTIVE/current ACTIVE OWNER, valid snapshot/scope, no existing membership. Creates ACTIVE membership revision 1 and one MembershipChanged CREATED with idempotency result atomically. Replay requires recipient ACTIVE and result membership ACTIVE, does not recheck inviter/expiry/roles. Fresh key on terminal state conflicts. Seven-day absolute expiry (expires_at <= current time), checked after locks. Idempotency success TTL 24h, key wait 2s; replay checks current rights before cached success, never requires PENDING. No invitation event. Error envelope and auth/session M1 unchanged.

RoleAssignment.description: ORG resource_id equals target organization_id (stored NULL internally). EVENT resource_id must resolve to the target org. UUIDs canonical lowercase.

slug.description: Optional explicit slug, trimmed and lowercase. When omitted, Identity generates a unique slug from name: NFD accents removed, Vietnamese đ mapped to d, lowercase ASCII letters/digits and hyphens; short names prefixed with org-, empty transliteration uses organization, maximum 63 characters. Collisions receive a UUID suffix. Explicit slug collisions still return 409 SLUG_TAKEN.

roles.description: Unordered set sorted by code/type/id after validation. Empty is permitted unless removing the final active OWNER.

AuthorizationInput.description: ORG resource_id must equal organization_id. EVENT org is resolved by the trusted owning service before calling; this endpoint does not verify the caller-supplied event/org relation.

email.description: Trimmed and lowercase; existing ACTIVE user only.

roles.description: Immutable server snapshot; unordered canonical set. ORG resource_id equals organization_id. EVENT must resolve to that organization.
